data.rationale: On 2026-09-02 Cameron explicitly authorized the scheduled Pinterest studio to test two different static posts per day, including a tasteful editorial-text style, through the verified production API. Authorization is capped at two Pins per local day, one per scheduled slot, and 12 new experiment Pins total; it does not authorize weak creatives, video-generation purchases, Sandbox publication, account changes, paid distribution, or spend.
